title: MCP installation gets a clearer path
summary:
Four community projects joined the showcase while the MCP package got a more usable installation path.

The MCP package was renamed to `@pollinations/model-context-protocol`, and its executable and Claude Desktop installer were updated to use the published package. The quick start was shortened, and the package now declares Node.js 14 as its minimum with an AbortController fallback for older versions.

The project showcase added toai.chat for terminal-based AI chat via curl and TeekGenAI for prompt-to-image generation without a login. Both are community-built ways to use Pollinations without building an interface first.

The community listings added a Chinese-language Telegram bot for chat, images, speech, and transcription, alongside IMyself AI, which offers image, text, and audio generation plus speech-to-text in Chinese and English.
